plan.objective: Measure CL14 throughput on the current optimized training pipeline.
plan.single_scientific_change: None. Skip only unrequested active-gradient diagnostics; limit startup validation to one unchanged batch for a bounded operational smoke.
plan.fixed_contract: CL14 model/data/loss/optimizer/schedule, batch 2, one A100, pose_adapt_ratio=0, ca_mixing_for_face=false, 2240/219217920 trainable contract; one 12-image startup validation batch.
plan.primary_metric: Median displayed seconds/iteration over optimizer steps 21-120; historical matched CL14 reference is 2.19 seconds/iteration.
plan.decision_gate: If the current median exceeds 2.30 seconds/iteration, diagnose current-stack overhead, implement a pipeline-neutral correction, and rerun. Otherwise stop after step 120 and record the result.
plan.risk: Operational smoke only; stop after the timing window and do not use its partial validation for scientific quality comparison.
